summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Admin Support Inbox at /admin/support-tickets. Logged in as admin@mercari.local, verified sidebar Support link + emerald unread badge (showed '1'), navigated to /admin/support-tickets, verified [data-testid=admin-support-page] renders with left rail listing 2 tickets. Exercised search (nomatch → 0), status filter (Closed → 0 open->closed available initially), and channel filter (Chat → 1). Opened an open ticket, sent a reply via Send button (msg count 3→4, new text visible in transcript within ~3s), sent another via Ctrl+Enter (also visible), then clicked Close (window.confirm accepted) — status pill flipped to 'closed', reply box replaced with 'This ticket is closed.' notice, Close button removed. Non-admin guard verified: sophia_style@demo.local logged in and navigating to /admin/support-tickets was redirected to '/' with no admin-support-page element rendered. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: React warning in console: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of TrustStrip.' — cosmetic but appears on every page load.
The 'This ticket is closed.' banner container has border-t without a color class (uses default) — very minor; contrast is fine.

action_items: (P3) Fix missing React key prop in TrustStrip.jsx to silence the recurring console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSupport.jsx (line ~301) uses className='border-t p-3 ...' without dark-mode border color; acceptable but inconsistent with the rest of the file which uses border-neutral-200 dark:border-neutral-800.
sendReply/closeTicket/openTicket all issue redundant GET after mutation (already returned by the mutation payload previously in prior iterations). Not a bug, just extra round-trips.

The conversation-refresh interval (POLL_MS=20s) recreates the interval on every setSelected because 'selected' is a dep — could cause slight drift; consider using selected?.id in dep array to be more precise. Not a functional issue.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@mercari.local / admin123; Seller: sophia_style@demo.local / demo1234
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing tickets (2 present: 'Question about seller fees' chat / 'Product not showing' email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Support Inbox is fully working. Two seed tickets exist in DB; the 'Question about seller fees' chat ticket was CLOSED by this test run (it started open with 2 messages, ended with 4 messages incl. two E2E admin replies, and is now status=closed). If future tests need an OPEN chat ticket, either reopen it via DB or have sophia_style create a new one. The 'Product not showing' email ticket remained open and had the emerald unread dot for admin.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
